race.comment: SURF'S UP (11) rewarded for her consistency with a fighting on speed third in the G2 Hot Danish Stakes over 1400m at this track with the 57kg. Two of her wins have come over the 1400m and sets up well with the 53kg. SUN GOD (3) has raced without luck all prep in much stronger company, including his latest fifth over 1600m at Flemington in the G2 Crystal Mile. Look for him to swoop late and take stopping. GLORIOUS MOMENTS (7) untapped gelding who was heavily supported on resumption with a gritty win from back in the field over 1300m at Newcastle. Goes to a new level today and the slight niggle is his record at this track and current price. ESTADIO MESTALLA (1) finally comes up with a good gate after drawing out in the Little Dance and The Gong last Saturday. Ticks a few boxes here. DANCE TO THE BOOM (9) tackles this trip for the first time and worth more than a passing glance with the 53kg.
